page.content:
Houston center for astronauts, Mission Control, and human spaceflight.

How Johnson Space Center connects

  • Topic: NASA — Johnson Space Center is NASA's human-spaceflight headquarters.
  • Creator: Christopher C. Kraft Jr. — Christopher Kraft designed Mission Control, later housed at Johnson.
  • Creator: Gene Kranz — Gene Kranz ran White Team shifts from Houston Mission Control.

What is Johnson Space Center?

Johnson Space Center in Houston houses Mission Control, the astronaut corps, and the Apollo and Shuttle training legacy that Kraft and Kranz built.

Key threads lead to NASA, Christopher C. Kraft Jr. and Gene Kranz.
